programs.salaryNote: Median Maximum Earning Potential, MBA 2023-25 (graduating 2025), audited final report (scanned; figure read from the page image).

salarySource.title: IIM Bodh Gaya Final Placement Report MBA/MBA-DBM/MBA-HHM 2023-25 (Audited by B2K Analytics, Nov 20, 2025)
salarySource.quote: MEDIAN AND AVERAGE MEP (IN LAKHS) - PLACED BY INSTITUTE: MBA'09 Overall Median 12.12, Average 13.10; Highest MEP INR 22.00 LPA (transcribed from scanned page 5; PDF has no text layer). NIRF 2025 cross-check (IR-M-U-1006): 1300001 for graduates of 2023-24.

cutoffs.notes: Stage: shortlisting (CAP 2026 invitation to submit EOI / PI, Gender-Neutral seats). CAT 2025, CAP 2026 (IIM Bodh Gaya, IIM Jammu, IIM Sirmaur; CAP portal cap2026.iimj.ac.in). Supernumerary Girls (SNG) cut-offs are lower: General 65/65/65, 85; EWS 50/50/50, 70; NC-OBC 45/45/45, 70; SC 40/40/40, 55; ST 25/30/30, 35; PwD 25/30/30, 35. The MBA Admission Policy 2026-28 PDF listed an earlier 'for reference only' table (GEN 75/75/75, 95; EWS 55/55/55, 81; NC-OBC 52/52/52, 81; SC 45/45/45, 66; ST/PwD 25/25/30, 42) to be 'finalized after the CAT 2025 result'; the EOI document is the finalized one. Academic eligibility: 'UG with 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD), Indian Citizens.'
